scripts.dev: sh -c "npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client"
scripts.backend:seed:test: NODE_ENV=development CORE_ADMIN_EMAIL=test.admin@aihealthcare.com CORE_ADMIN_PASSWORD=AdminTest2026 CORE_ADMIN_FIRST_NAME=Test CORE_ADMIN_LAST_NAME=Admin CORE_NURSE_EMAIL=test.doctor@aihealthcare.com CORE_NURSE_PASSWORD=DoctorTest2026 CORE_NURSE_FIRST_NAME=Test CORE_NURSE_LAST_NAME=Doctor CORE_USER_EMAIL=test.patient@aihealthcare.com CORE_USER_PASSWORD=PatientTest2026 CORE_USER_FIRST_NAME=Test CORE_USER_LAST_NAME=Patient npm run seed:core --prefix server
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.check:client: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.check:server: node --check server/server.js && node --input-type=module -e "import('./server/Config/env.js').then(() => console.log('Server env config valid'))"
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --prefix client --omit=dev && npm audit --prefix server --omit=dev
scripts.audit:all: sh -c 'npm audit --prefix client; c=$?; npm audit --prefix server; s=$?; test $c -eq 0 -a $s -eq 0'
